Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Apple (AAPL) Holder Cutler Capital Management Lowered Holding by $709,632; Seminole Management Has Increased Holding in Total S A (TOT) as Share Price Rose 
March 13, 2018 - By Ellis Scott 
Michael Messner increased its stake in Total S A (TOT) by 16.96% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Seminole Management bought 117,400 shares as the company’s stock rose 7.42% with the market. The hedge fund run by Michael Messner held 809,682 shares of the energy company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $43.33M, up from 692,282 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Seminole Management who had been investing in Total S A for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $150.52 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.40% or $0.23 during the last trading session, reaching $57.47. About 870,483 shares traded. TOTAL S.A. (NYSE:TOT) has risen 13.67% since March 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.03% the S&P500. 
Cutler Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 20.5% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cutler Capital Management Llc sold 4,608 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 17,866 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.75M, down from 22,474 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cutler Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $922.05B market cap company. The stock increased 0.97% or $1.74 during the last trading session, reaching $181.72. About 32.21M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
Among 24 analysts covering Total SA ( NYSE:TOT ), 13 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 10 Hold. Therefore 54% are positive. Total SA had 38 analyst reports since August 24, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was initiated by BMO Capital Markets with “Outperform” on Monday, September 28. As per Tuesday, September 22, the company rating was upgraded by Societe Generale. On Thursday, December 21 the stock rating was maintained by Scotia Capital with “Hold”. The firm earned “Sector Outperform” rating on Thursday, October 8 by Howard Weil. The firm has “Hold” rating by Canaccord Genuity given on Monday, April 18. JP Morgan downgraded the shares of TOT in report on Friday, December 8 to “Underweight” rating. The company was maintained on Thursday, July 27 by Cowen & Co. The stock has “Buy” rating by Cowen & Co on Tuesday, October 24. The company was downgraded on Monday, September 21 by Tudor Pickering. The stock of TOTAL S.A. (NYSE:TOT) earned “Hold” rating by Piper Jaffray on Tuesday, January 23. 
Since October 3, 2017, it had 0 buys, and 5 selling transactions for $26.38 million activity. SCHILLER PHILIP W sold $8.79M worth of stock or 56,808 shares. $9.78 million worth of stock was sold by AHRENDTS ANGELA J on Tuesday, October 3. 
Cutler Capital Management Llc, which manages about $356.71 million and $224.69 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Colony Capital (Prn) by 1.01 million shares to 1.71 million shares, valued at $1.75M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Citizens First Bank (NASDAQ:CZFC) by 14,675 shares in the quarter, for a total of 55,000 shares, and has risen its stake in Weyerhaeuser (NYSE:WY). 
Investors sentiment increased to 0.7 in Q3 2017. Its up 0.02, from 0.68 in 2017Q2. It is positive, as 52 investors sold AAPL shares while 1034 reduced holdings. 116 funds opened positions while 640 raised stakes. 2.97 billion shares or 2.78% less from 3.06 billion shares in 2017Q2 were reported. Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1. They expect $2.72 earnings per share, up 29.52% or $0.62 from last year’s $2.1 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $13.80 billion for 16.70 P/E if the $2.72 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.08% negative EPS growth.   Ellis Scott
